scope: Two frozen full High day High Perches pictures only. Current appearance, visible paving/ground union, near trainer/route and landed vista readability; no matched before/after claim.

inspection.coverage: Both complete originals and complete contact inspected. No crops, retouching or other corpus inspection for this task.

overall_pictured_appearance.reason: The court is identifiable and its central paving is coherent, but large pillars have coarse repeated brown surface detail with stretched/warped-looking stone bands, surrounding turf is broad and uniform, and the vista frame has severe overlapping companion silhouettes. These remain below the coherent reference-backed shape/material/readability bar.

owning_requirements: Reference-backed coherent architecture/materials and integrated terrain contact.
Clear actor silhouettes without gross visible interpenetration.
Readable route and scenery. Still appearance cannot establish camera behavior, physics, earned traversal or timing.

central_paving_ground_continuity.reason: The circular blue/gold stone court reads as a continuous slab in landing, with a continuous visible outer edge. The vista foreground paving also reads continuously. No large grass wedges cut across the pictured central paving.
central_paving_ground_continuity.limits: Only the visible court surface/edges; hidden rear sections, beneath actors and complete perimeter are not inspected.

visible_perimeter_contact.reason: Visible ring edge, round banner stand and pillar base bands meet the surrounding grass without an obvious large unsupported base gap or broad grass cut through the paving.
visible_perimeter_contact.limits: Sparse grass blades occur around base edges; these stills do not certify concealed junctions, collision or all-side contact.

near_trainer_route_readability.reason: The trainer's full body and feet remain legible on grass in both frames. The landing frame leaves an open near approach toward the central circle, and the vista frame leaves an open near lane toward the banner stand. No gross trainer burial or actor obstruction of the near trainer is visible.
near_trainer_route_readability.limits: Pictured surface readability only; no supported-stand physics, movement, landing transition or route reachability inference.

landed_vista_orientation.reason: Blue banner, adjacent pillar, horizon/cloud deck and distant cliff fragments provide local orientation and an open-sky vista.
landed_vista_orientation.limits: The near terrain edge/drop is not exposed clearly enough to certify high-perch drop/height legibility. The left vista is partly covered by companions.

height_drop_camera_coverage.reason: Neither full image supplies an unobstructed near cliff edge/downward view from which the perch's actual drop can be read. Arrival, departure and landing transition are absent.

companion_silhouette_separation.reason: In vista, the large insect head/body and pale wings lie directly over the bird's head/chest/raised wings. The two bodies form a fused overlapping silhouette and obscure part of the left vista. Landing shows the nearer bird clearly, with the insect farther back.
companion_silhouette_separation.limits: Visible static overlap only; no cause, collision, ownership, motion or behavior claim.

findings: Central circular stone paving and blue/gold spokes are legible and uninterrupted by broad green wedges.
Trainer is fully visible; the approach to the center remains open. Near bird feet/body are distinct.
Very large repeated brown pillars dominate the frame; coarse mottling and distorted-looking stone ring patterning limit material finish.
Broad lightly dressed green floor lacks the layered upland terrain character of the reference. No near drop is exposed.
views.unseen: Rear/all-side perimeter, cliff drop, airborne arrival/departure and motion.

findings: Foreground court paving and circular banner pad read as stone and meet grass without a large visible gap.
Trainer and near lane remain unobscured; banner and sky give orientation.
Bird and insect bodies/wings severely overlap on the left, reducing actor identity separation and vista readability.
Pillar's coarse repeated material, uniform turf and simple orange rail pieces remain below the full appearance finish. The near drop is not legible.
views.unseen: Hidden court edges, terrain underside/support, landing transition, airborne camera and cliff/drop view.

context_limits: Legacy production-camera landed/staged presentation context with debug scene/boot flags and pinned day. Weather is not explicitly pinned; only the pictured sky is judged. No HUD/text overlay is visible in these two originals.
